definitions.explanation: Refers to each individual item or person within a group, emphasizing them as separate entities rather than as a collective.

examples.japanese: {個々|ここ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}する→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧。
examples.english: To take individual circumstances into consideration.

examples.japanese: {個々|ここ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Instruction tailored to individual abilities is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{個々|ここ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{捉|とら}える→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Rather than examining each issue individually, we need to grasp them as a whole.

notes:
Typically used with the particle ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns: {個々|ここ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (each individual problem). Can also be used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {個々|ここ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to deal with each one individually).

A homophone of ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧ (here), but written in kanji so there is no ambiguity in text.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個々|ここ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧ — individual cases
- {個々|ここ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ — individual handling
- {個々|ここ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — individually; separately
- {個々|ここ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ — individual differences
